A disruption broke out during Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge’s address at the 139th birth anniversary celebration of Dr Shri Krishna Singh in Patna, Bihar. After a person at the event reportedly said that Prime Minister Narendra Modi would not go anywhere, Kharge responded sharply. Watch the exchange.
